title: CLI for the michi binary
body: Deferred until the parser exists. Covers run, dry run, choosing a pipeline by name, what a shebang run does with several pipelines in a file, and swapping a dataset without editing the file.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: A provisional `michi sh FILE` prints the bash script, and `michi FILE` parses and resolves. Both are placeholders for the real command line.
